Fantasy NBA 数据服务 v1.0.0

- Initial release providing a data API for the Fantasy NBA Israel league (MCP server).
- Supports statistics, rankings, and analysis of all league teams.
- Requires API key configuration on first use; prompts user if missing.
- Enforces strict API workflow: acts only as a router, delegating all data logic to API/tool functions.
- Includes comprehensive tool selection rules for accessing league rankings, team lists, team stats, and detailed team information.
